name: Don't You Squidward
aka: You Like Krabby Patties Don't You Squidward
look: SpongeBob, wearing his white and teal work hat tilted on his head, gives a sly, knowing grin with half-closed eyes and raised brows. He stands in a dim teal kitchen with a round metal door and squeeze bottles on a counter behind him.
use: Calls someone out for secretly enjoying something they claim to dislike. The top caption states what they really like, and the bottom caption adds SpongeBob's smug tag "don't you, Squidward?"
slots: top caption: 'You like...' plus what they secretly enjoy
examples: You like the song you said was overplayed
You say you hate reality TV but you've seen every season
describe: spongebob smirking slyly with his hat on crooked
spongebob with a smug knowing grin
sneaky spongebob face raising his eyebrows
spongebob teasing someone for secretly liking something
yellow sponge with a sly smile in the krusty krab kitchen
origin: A still of a smug SpongeBob from SpongeBob SquarePants, tied to his line "You like Krabby Patties, don't you, Squidward?"
